fusions.name: Haymaker Shove
fusions.desc: Throws your whole weight behind one fist: it deals 18 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Two-Fisted Quake
fusions.desc: Brings both fists down on the ground, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Top of the Troop
fusions.desc: Asserts your strength over the group: you and every ally within 5 tiles strike 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fight with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Bone-Deep Heft
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: your damage rises 4% per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
